decisions.reason: The sewer pipe cleaning box fits the firm's fluid-handling and utility customer base and uses its existing steel fabrication and coating capabilities.

Public waste bins are further from the core offer, but they serve existing public-sector buyers and use the firm's metal fabrication and in-house surface treatment, so the firm will likely give them more time despite higher risk.
Ground sleeves for posts are simple fabricated parts that build on established capabilities and are cheap to keep in the portfolio.
Cast iron ground sleeves complement the sleeve range for municipal customers, though cast material may rely on sourcing, so the risk is slightly higher.
Steel ground sleeves match the firm's core steel processing and coating expertise and round out the product family.
